column1: # tests/perf_budgets.tsv — helper-spawn and profile-counter budgets for the
#   noop / dryrun_incr               default CLI fixture, 25 datasets x 4
#   noop_small / dryrun_incr_small   CI fixture, 8 datasets x 2 snapshots
# RATCHET-DOWN-ONLY RULE: these budgets may only ever DECREASE. When an
# optimization lands and the observed counts drop, lower max to
# ceil(new-observed * 1.15) in the same change. Never raise a budget to make
# a regression pass; a budget failure means the change reintroduced
# per-run process spawns or structural work that Phase 0 pinned away.
# Seeded 2026-06-10 from three -V runs each of
# on the macOS baseline host with max = ceil(observed * 1.15). All
# non-timing rows were identical across runs AND across both fixture sizes
# (spawn counts do not scale with dataset count today), so the _small and
# full budgets start equal. Observed baselines: noop TOTAL=176 (sed=43
# awk=34 date=17 ps=3 od=0 tr=2, runtime_artifact_files_created=14,
# Never budget advisory:* rows (wall time is timing noise, not a contract).
